title: Recent advances and challenges in thermoelectrics toward near-room-temperature and high-temperature applications
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2026, 55,2265-2324
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS01211B, Review Article
Qianhui Lou, Jiayan Gong, Zizheng Zang, Sheng Qian, Yu Liu, Yu Zhang, Yuechu Wang, Shen Han, Chenguang Fu, Tiejun Zhu
This review analyzes thermoelectrics for near-room-temperature cooling and mid-to-high-temperature power generation, discussing advances and challenges over the past five years.
